topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't believe it. Here I am, trying to keep this classroom running smoothly, and I get this package. A former student, of all people. What is this, some kind of joke? I didn’t need a reminder of the chaos they brought into my life. Opening it, of course, it’s one of those overly sentimental cards, dripping with false gratitude. I don’t have time for this. I’ve got lessons to plan, grades to enter, and the mountain of paperwork isn’t getting any smaller. If they really wanted to thank me, they’d make sure I didn’t have to deal with this nonsense. Some gratitude, right? Just what I needed today.
